title: Detection Rule Governance, Dual-Control Approval, Rule Versioning, Version Impact Analysis, and Immutable Governance Auditability

invariants_enforced.enforcement: HTTP 409 Conflict with code SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN and immutable security event SELF_APPROVAL_BLOCKED

invariants_enforced.rule: ACTIVE detection rules are never modified in place; modifications instantiate new version records in DRAFT status
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Sequential version numbering (v1 -> v2 -> v3) and SHA-256 version hash seal

invariants_enforced.rule: DRAFT cannot transition directly to ACTIVE. Strict sequence: DRAFT -> PENDING_REVIEW -> APPROVED -> ACTIVE
invariants_enforced.enforcement: State transition validation machine blocks direct or out-of-order activation

invariants_enforced.rule: Only one ACTIVE version may exist per logical detection rule
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Activating an APPROVED version atomically supersedes the existing ACTIVE version to SUPERSEDED status in single DB transaction

invariants_enforced.rule: Version hashes sealed with prefix SENTINELTRACE_RULE_VERSION_V1; Governance events sealed with SENTINELTRACE_DETECTION_GOVERNANCE_V1
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Canonical JSON serialization and SHA-256 integrity checks

invariants_enforced.rule: Pre-approval trust simulation inspects dependencies and drift without mutating runtime Sprint 6B trust tables
invariants_enforced.enforcement: Pure functional simulation returning hypothetically scored state
